orgDesign.companyProfile: Global travel marketplace centered on accommodation demand, partner supply, payments, servicing, and high-scale marketplace economics.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Traveler-facing teams own discovery, booking, and trip confidence while partner-facing teams own supply quality, connectivity, and commercial performance. Shared trust, payments, intelligence, and platform teams provide cross-marketplace control functions.
designPrinciples: Keep traveler conversion and partner supply quality in the same operating system because marketplace economics depend on both at once.
Treat payments, trust, and connectivity as first-class shared capabilities rather than product afterthoughts.
Separate hotel-style commercial depth from small-host simplicity while keeping a common marketplace core.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for traveler growth, partner growth, and marketplace foundations.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
